title: System Architecture
scope_summary: Comprehensive architectural reference for the BoosterSimApp macOS menu-bar app — covers SwiftUI/AppKit hybrid entry point, AppDelegate service wiring, all core and feature services (window tracking, permissions, network traffic capture via PulseServer/Bonjour, environment overrides, certificates, accessibility inspection), window management (NSPanel, spring animation, position calculation), data models, view hierarchy with tab-based side panel, utilities, data flow diagrams, concurrency model, and key design decisions.
